red.name: Red dwarf
red.text: Small, cool and patient: it will outlive everything else.
red.boon: Often left unguarded: about half hold a find, most often materials, sometimes cards or an emblem.
red.cost: Its worlds are poor: 1 material less when taken.

white.name: White dwarf
white.text: The hot, dense core of a star that died long ago.
white.boon: The archives of the dead: about 2 in 5 hold a find, most often cards, sometimes an emblem.
white.cost: Battles here are long: every sun starts 2 cooler.

brown.name: Brown dwarf
brown.text: A failed star, barely warm. Easy to overlook; hard to dig out.
brown.boon: Easy to overlook: more often than not a find, cards or an emblem.
brown.cost: When it is guarded, its defender has +3 max health.

neutron.name: Neutron star
neutron.text: A city-sized star spinning hundreds of times a second; its beam sweeps the dark.
neutron.boon: Rarely unguarded, but what it hides is rare: most often an emblem, or cards.
neutron.cost: Battles here are volatile: every sun heats by 1 each day.

blackHole.name: Supermassive Black Hole
blackHole.text: A supermassive black hole lies beneath this galaxy, its well drinking heat: every sun has +2 max health, but every opening hand is 1 card smaller.

pulsar.name: Pulsar
pulsar.text: A pulsar's beam sweeps this galaxy, steadying every sun: each cools by 1 every day, but has 2 less max health.
pulsar.short: suns cool 1 each day · 2 less max health

meteors.name: Meteor Shower
meteors.text: Meteors rain through this galaxy: every sun starts 2 hotter, and every heat wave from the Stellari strikes every card for 1 too; but every opening hand is 1 card bigger.
meteors.short: suns start 2 hotter · heat waves strike cards for 1 · opening hand 1 bigger

nebula.name: Nebula
nebula.text: This galaxy lies deep in a nebula, hidden in its gas: every side gains 1 shield every day, but every sun starts 1 hotter.
nebula.short: +1 shield each day · suns start 1 hotter

darkMatter.name: Dark Matter
darkMatter.text: Unseen mass threads this galaxy: every side draws 1 extra card every day, but a heat wave from the Stellari heats every sun by 1 every day, and strikes every card for 1.
darkMatter.short: draw 1 extra each day · daily heat wave: suns +1, cards 1

mine.name: Antimatter Mine
mine.text: Crystals of antimatter, growing in the dark: break as many as you can in 6 days. They heat your sun while they stand.

lord.name: Lost Lord
lord.text: The last lord of a Lost Race, with their retinue: beat the lord down. Like an Overlord, they play no cards, and take one great action a day.
lord.reward: the Lost Lord joins your deck

frost.name: The Frost Line
frost.text: Wave after wave out of the cold: survive 6 days (a day more for each Frost Line held before). Each is harder than the last.
frost.reward: +5 max health on your sun for good, or 6 cooling now

rift.name: Rift
rift.text: Enter rift? You may not come back.
rift.reward: a Lost Race's galaxy, and its ruler

overlords.name: The Hollow Colossus
overlords.blurb: A vast construct of a race long dead, its furnace still burning. Its fists crush; its plating turns every blow.

overlords.name: The Mother of Maws
overlords.blurb: The brood-queen of a hive that ate its own stars. Her claws rend, her maw devours, and her young never stop coming.

overlords.name: The Ashen Tyrant
overlords.blurb: The last king of a burned-out empire, still in his armour. His greatsword cleaves; his shield and retainers keep him standing.

missions.name: Cold Victory
missions.text: Win a battle with your sun at 0 or colder.
